notes.text:
An update is available for freerdp.
This update affects Rocky Linux 10.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
FreeRDP is a free implementation of the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP), released under the Apache license. The xfreerdp client can connect to RDP servers such as Microsoft Windows machines, xrdp, and VirtualBox.

Security Fix(es):

* freerdp: FreeRDP: Denial of Service via uninitialized progressive tile handling (CVE-2026-109242)

* freerdp: FreeRDP 3.0.0-beta1 before 3.32.0 Use-After-Free via Smartcard Connect (CVE-2026-109676)

* freerdp: FreeRDP: Unauthenticated keystroke injection via premature input dispatch (CVE-2026-110838)

* freerdp: freerdp: Denial of Service via file descriptor exhaustion in serial device handling (CVE-2026-110830)

* freerdp: freerdp: Denial of Service via heap-based buffer overflow during MP3 audio decoding (CVE-2026-110837)

* freerdp: freerdp: Denial of Service via unbounded memory consumption during RDPDR reassembly (CVE-2026-110833)

* freerdp: FreeRDP: Denial of Service via grayscale JPEG clipboard conversion (CVE-2026-110839)

* freerdp: freerdp: Denial of Service via memory exhaustion in NLA frame parser (CVE-2026-111378)

* freerdp: FreeRDP: Arbitrary code execution via crafted persistent cache file (CVE-2026-111379)

* freerdp: freerdp: Arbitrary code execution via crafted persistent cache file (CVE-2026-111381)

* freerdp: freerdp: Arbitrary code execution via crafted display frames (CVE-2026-111382)

* freerdp: freerdp: Denial of Service via heap out-of-bounds write in NTLM authentication (CVE-2026-111880)

* freerdp: FreeRDP: heap buffer overflow in server rdpsnd via crafted audio formats (CVE-2026-114045)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Rebase FreeRDP to 3.32.2 or newer [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-277442)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
